title: Force Lightning
text: Choose a unit. It loses all abilities for this phase. Then, if you control a FORCE unit, pay any number of resources and deal 2 damage to the chosen unit for each resource paid this way.
rules:
The chosen unit can still gain new abilities later in the phase, including the abilities it lost.
All damage dealt by a single ability is dealt simultaneously.
The chosen unit can't gain abilities for this phase.
